news.title: Chambal Breweries and Distilleries Limited Announces Resignation of Parasram Jhamnani as Managing Director, Effective January 18, 2026
news.body: Chambal Breweries and Distilleries Limited announced that Mr. Parasram Jhamnani resigned as Managing Director with effect from January 18, 2026, consequent to change in management by takeover.

news.title: Chambal Breweries and Distilleries Limited Announces Resignation of Directors and Appointment of Additional Independent Director, Effective January 18, 2026
news.body: Chambal Breweries and Distilleries Limited announced that Mrs. Amrita Modi resigned as Director, Mr. Rinku Goyal resigned as Independent Director, and Mr. Anmol Jindal resigned as Independent Director, all with effect from January 18, 2026, consequent to change in management by takeover. The company appointed Mr. Gaurav Sharma as an Additional Independent Director on January 18, 2026. Mr. Gaurav Sharma is a seasoned HR leader with over 22 years of experience across large, complex, and diversified organizations. He holds a PGDBA (2002), has completed an ESG program from IICA, and has pursued Leadership in AI from ISB Hyderabad, reflecting his focus on future-ready leadership. Mr. Rinku Goyal is an Independent Director at Vivran Agritech Limited and a Director at W Health Ventures Advisory I

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 6.9% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks.
